notes.title: Development Update #1: Hit Refresh - Characters Redesign and new UI
notes.notes:
[p]Hey folks!
I’m Gabriel Schade, the solo developer behind [b]Elidriel[/b]. Starting today, I want to begin a new tradition: [b]monthly updates[/b] about the game! [/p][p]The page has been quiet for a while, and I’m excited to change that.[/p][p]I’ve been working really hard on [i][b]Elidriel[/b][/i] since the demo first launched, and now I have some exciting things to share with you:[/p][p][/p][h1]Our beloved characters received a full redesign with brand-new, polished artwork![/h1][p][/p][h2][b][i]Ada[/i][/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156163/808c9b33b70cd170e11f57ecfe5fdc44b6c9dd18.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b][i]Helena[/i][/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156163/43becbe64dd3cf7161552bd117ee57e8ab13e5c4.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b][i]Kell[/i][/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156163/5d6ffae1cc46e61478e8105a5ea71f3ab2872287.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b][i]Erling[/i][/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156163/731cf1e27a58558225264ac97064b5b5e5b90c6b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b][i]Emmy[/i][/b][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156163/9a280ba0ecebda46369050920e98e55f2dd8ec36.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]To match the new art style, the menu also got a complete visual update.[/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156163/ba9cba9601003bab854e7cc2e6366527a55b0054.png"][/img][/p][p][b][i]Elidriel[/i][/b] is now fully playable in crisp Full HD (1080p), so you can enjoy the new visuals at their best.[/p][p]This is just the beginning—I can’t wait to share more with you. [/p][p]A [b]new demo[/b] will be coming soon (before Q1 2026), featuring all these updated assets and giving you a taste of what the release version will look like.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for following along and supporting this journey.[/p][p]Until next time,
[b]Gabriel[/b]
[i]Solo & Passionate Indie Game Developer[/i][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Live Stream with the Developer
notes.notes:
[h1]Welcome to Elidriel![/h1]

[h3]Get your popcorn, sit down and relax as we go over different save files showing mechanics, characters, environments and of course, at least one boss battle![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156163/cdeb5d0086e356e8de36a0f7bdc2ee02ea92958d.png[/img]

We will be live during the event!

notes.title: Elidriel - Major Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Helena [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156163/fca12f8ff5a4732bccd18baecf3afa0b2b43cfe7.png[/img]
[b]Helena [/b]is a brand new playable character, with a unique [b]parry[/b] ability! This ability will prevent the entire damage and perform a counter attack right away! It's all up to you as a player to be able to react as quick as the damage would be dealt.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156163/1fe5a4fa2459647416f4259aa92436929a370860.png[/img]

[b]Helena [/b]is a part of the group during the demo version and can be used as any other character! But she is insanely strong, she can even beat dragons. But wait, wasn't she a foe? 

What's going on?! Know more about [b]Ada [/b]and [b]Helena [/b]past in this updated demo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156163/bfc81a0717665d377b3af23c181c7851644da1f2.png[/img]

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]New ways to explore the world[/h1]

Now it's possible to explore [b]Elidriel[/b]'s world like nothing before!

You can [b]swim [/b]across lakes and rivers, [b]climb[/b] mountains and cross narrow places that requires concentration and [b]balance[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156163/2a8605fe17244a38d8d37b67835971c866dd77ec.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156163/8c3507a51e3a5767be4982c830a0a578888a93b4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156163/64a1bd47e775646aa0f50e20db935ebe29f02652.png[/img]
